_readme:
Read the BODY of the archived per-company pages, not only the CDX index.

`cdx_company_pages` enumerates /portfolio/<slug> from the index and stops there,
so 175 of Khosla's 429 archived slugs land unnamed -- and they are the modern,
high-value half of the book (openai, gitlab, rubrik, commonwealth-fusion-systems,
hermeus, varda-space-industries, sword-health, ultima-genomics, waabi, synchron).
COLLECTION.md §5's Common Crawl rule already says the body is the evidence; the
same is true of the IA replay, and on this site the body carries four fields the
index cannot:

  name          <title> "Anchorage | Khosla Ventures"; the FIRST <h1> is the
                company and wraps its own outbound URL. (The SECOND <h1> is the
                footer's "About Khosla Ventures" -- an <h1>-first parser
                publishes that as the company name on every row. Measured here.)
  abstract      the firm's own description
  categories    the firm's own sector tags, /portfolio/<sector> links
  founded /     <table class=dates> -- the firm's own founding year and its own
  invested      INVESTMENT year. Read `invested` as a CLOSE year, never an
                announcement date (COLLECTION.md §6, the Menlo rule), and score
                it on the golden set before it is allowed to label anything.

A slug never names a row (COLLECTION.md §5.1a), so this exists precisely so the
one-word slugs (block, rocket, go, fresh, even, plum, swift, castle) reach the
judge as the firm's own rendering rather than as a guess.

Writes: sources/wayback/company-pages.json
Usage:  python3 scratch/company-pages.py [slugs.json]

scribd.description: Scribd is the premier subscription reading service with more than 500,000 titles, including New York Times bestsellers, classics, and reader favorites in every genre.

seamicro.name: SeaMicro
seamicro.description: SeaMicro develops solutions that address power inefficiencies in data centers. The company created the microserver category and is the only company with a second generation fabric server with over 1.28 Tbps bandwidth. shoes-of-prey.name: Shoes of Prey

silicium-energy.description: Silicium is developing silicon thermoelectrics that enable substantially increased battery longevity for wearable electronics. simpler.description: Simpler makes on-boarding seamless. With Simpler, you can send new hires their packet as easily as one email. They can fill everything out in a browser while you track their progress and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

Sliced makes the investment process simple by automating payments, tax information and communication. Investors can get started immediately with as little as $20,000.

smarking.description: Smarking un-taps the parking industry’s potential via predictive data analytics. Smarking solves the information imbalance problem between the drivers and parking facilities.

square.name: Square

strut.name: Strut
strut.description: Strut is your guide into the world of style. Each day you see a curated selection of items. Swipe right to save an item, swipe left to skip it.

supernova.name: Supernova

swift.name: Swift Capital
swift.description: Swift Capital’s mission is to unleash the potential of small businesses by providing them with the working capital they need when traditional banks fall short.

tabnine.name: TabNine

tapingo.name: Tapingo
tapingo.description: Tapingo is disrupting the way people shop on and around college campuses.

teespring.name: Teespring
teespring.description: Teespring is a commerce platform that enables anyone to design and sell products that people love. Teespring powers all aspects of bringing merchandise to life from production and manufacturing to supply chain, logistics and customer service. By simplifying commerce, Teespring is creating new opportunities for entrepreneurs, social media influencers, community organizers, sports fans and students who rally communities around particular causes or specific passions.

teleborder.name: Teleborder
teleborder.description: Teleborder offers HR management systems to manage the immigration process of companies’ management, employees and new hires.

tenxer.name: TenXer

terrapower.name: TerraPower
terrapower.description: TerraPower is a nuclear energy technology company that is working to raise living standards globally. The company’s goal is to provide the world with a more affordable, secure and environmentally friendly form of nuclear energy.

theatro.name: Theatro
theatro.description: Theatro has pioneered the first voice controlled wearable device coupled with a software suite of productivity applications for brick and mortar retail, hospitality and manufacturing enterprises. The company’s heads-up and hands free mobile communications and management solution, delivered over WiFi to a workforce of hourly employees, is the perfect on-the-go solution. Theatro increases productivity, provides management teams with unprecedented insights and enables hourly employees to access the information they need to provide an enhanced level of customer service.

thoughtspot.description: ThoughtSpot aims to address the broken business intelligence model in the enterprise and radically increase the speed of information access for more than 20 million users by 2020. ThoughtSpot Analytical Search Appliance is a plug-and-play solution that provides a search-based user experience for business data access and analysis. tile.name: Tile
tile.description: Tile believes that technology, design and ingenuity can solve problems that most people take for granted. Life’s little inconveniences add up: the average person misplaces upwards of 3,000 items a year, and then spends another 60 hours a year searching for them. All told, misplaced stuff adds up to billions of dollars annually. Tile believes that simple solutions, applied in a new way, can have powerful results. The company aims to create products that enable a happier, more efficient world.

timeful.name: Timeful
timeful.description: Timeful is a technology company dedicated to reinventing the way that people manage their most precious resource: time. The company takes an algorithmic approach to time management, and leverages big data and behavioral science to best determine how people can maximize their lives.

touchstone.name: Touchstone

varentec.description: Varentec provides products and solutions that achieve smarter power delivery for its customers. The company builds power management and monitoring solutions for the electric grid.

vectra-networks.name: Vectra Networks
vectra-networks.description: Vectra Networks redefines security with a platform that instantly identifies cyber attacks while they are happening as well as what the attacker is doing. Vectra automatically prioritizes attacks that pose the greatest business risk, which enables organizations to quickly make decisions on where to focus their time and resources. The automated platform uses next-generation compute architecture and combines data analytics and machine learning to detect attacks on any device, application and operating system.

veev.name: Veev

velo3d.description: Velo3D develops end-to-end solutions for metal additive manufacturing, including metal printing systems, physical simulation-based print preparation software, and an adaptive manufacturing process. vert.name: Vert
vert.description: Vert is productizing the home design and construction market. Our modular, panelized approach reduces costs and construction time and introduces innovative methods and materials. Vert…Engineered for Life.

vibrado.name: Vibrado
vibrado.description: Vibrado is using wearable technology to help people move more effectively, efficiently and safely. Vibrado’s team is passionate about improving athletes’ skills, from beginning athletes learning proper form to elite athletes striving to perform consistently at a high level.

vicarious.description: Computers are currently unable to understand the sensory experience of a human. These uncertainties have foiled our best efforts to create automated systems for understanding the world as we experience it. Vicarious is building the next generation of artificial intelligence algorithms to better understand our world.

vicarious-surgical.name: Vicarious Surgical
vicarious-surgical.description: Vicarious Surgical integrates virtual reality with surgical robotics.

vida-health.name: Vida Health
vida-health.description: Vida is set to disrupt the mobile healthcare space, which will be $25B by 2018. view-glass.name: View Glass

viome-inc.name: Viome, Inc.
viome-inc.description: Viome is a team of leading entrepreneurs, scientists, and physicians. Webflow generates valid markup and style sheets, so users can trust that the generated code is clean. Webflow automatically adds code to render consistently across different browsers. yammer.name: Yammer
yammer.description: Yammer is an enterprise social network established to foster team collaboration, empower employees and drive business transformation. It enables employees to collaborate in real time across departments, geographies and business applications. It also helps them create groups to collaborate on projects and share and edit documents. The company was acquired by Microsoft.

yume.name: YuMe
yume.description: YuMe is a leading provider of digital video brand advertising solutions. YuMe is now listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: YUME).

zebra.name: Zebra
zebra.description: Zebra is a next generation medical data research platform.

zenefits.name: Zenefits
zenefits.description: Zenefits lets you manage all your HR—payroll, benefits, compliance, and more—online, in one beautiful dashboard. Seamlessly connect your company’s payroll, health insurance, paid time off, and other HR systems with Zenefits in just a few seconds without having to change vendors, plans, or pricing. And if your business doesn’t have these things yet, Zenefits can give you quotes and set you up in just a couple of minutes.

zocdoc.name: Zocdoc
zocdoc.description: Zocdoc is the tech company at the beginning of a better healthcare experience.
